subject: pol-dym
title: POL.DYM.------PROG.CONT.
description: Diagram in T(AF)M-24, paired with v1-p120-1. POL-DYM (political dynamics) is crossed with PROG-CONT (progressional continuance): what does it mean to make political dynamics *continuous* with the progressional thrust of black creativity, rather than letting political dynamics merely *interrupt* progressional flow? POL-DYM branches to DE-SPTL (despiritualization) → EXT-FT (extended functionalism) → INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis) → INTL (intellectualism) → MOT-DYM. Besides the main line to PROG-CONT, POL-DYM runs to T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) → COS-P (cosmic particulars) → AF-NT (affinity nature) → SOC-RT-P (social reality particulars).
